description: This Scala source file defines the RealTimeModeAllowlist object, which manages allowlists for sinks and operators in Spark's streaming real-time mode, including functions to check if sinks and operators are permitted, and to collect relevant nodes in Spark plans.

classes.name: RealTimeModeAllowlist
classes.description: Object managing allowlists for sinks and operators in Spark streaming real-time mode, with methods to check and collect nodes.

methods.name: classNamesString
methods.description: Creates a message with sorted class names, indicating if multiple classes are involved.

methods.name: notInRTMAllowlistException
methods.description: Constructs an exception for classes not in the allowlist, with error type and class names.

methods.name: checkAllowedSink
methods.description: Checks if a sink is in the allowed list; throws exception or logs warning.

methods.name: collectRealtimeNodes
methods.description: Recursively collects SparkPlan nodes whose subtree contains RealTimeStreamScanExec.

methods.name: checkAllowedPhysicalOperator
methods.description: Checks if operators in a SparkPlan are in the allowlist; throws exception or logs warning.
